brief: 32-second pre-opening promo for A Tennis Lab (ATL), an indoor tennis training studio in Seattle, opening soon. Facts allowed (and only these): 4 half-court training lanes plus a practice wall called The Wall; programmable ball machines; human coaching; rigorous, focused practice that turns into progress you can take into matches; each session picks up where the last left off (下次接着练); atennislab.com; call to action: Join the waitlist. Forbidden: any AI / smart / algorithm language or imagery implying it, pricing, address, hours, dates, stats, testimonials. Tone: serious, premium training brand. Colour: Roland-Garros palette - terracotta clay, white lines, deep green surrounds, cream type; no dark + tennis-yellow look. Picture: one three.js studio world with cinematic lighting, materials, depth of field and motivated camera moves: lights strike on over a clay lane; a crane reveals four lanes and The Wall; a programmable machine aims and feeds three targets; a slow-motion racket strike; last session's ball marks stay in the clay while today's land tighter; a rally on a full match court; closing card. Sound: synthesized in the composition; every ball contact (racket, clay, wall, machine) is an audible, distinct hit; a restrained harmonic bed under it.
